summary:
Red Planet Crea is an interactive mapping platform designed to support future human exploration of Mars. The project combines multiple datasets related to Martian terrain, elevation, geological features, and environmental conditions into a unified and user-friendly map.

The platform helps explorers identify safe routes, locate scientific points of interest, and better understand the surrounding environment before and during exploration activities. By visualizing critical information in a layered mapping system, users can make informed decisions and improve mission planning efficiency.

Our goal is to transform complex Mars data into practical navigation and exploration tools that contribute to safer and more successful interplanetary missions.
details:
Red Planet Crea is an interactive Mars exploration platform designed to help future astronauts and researchers navigate the Martian surface safely and efficiently.

The platform combines multiple NASA datasets into a unified and user-friendly interactive map. Users can visualize Martian terrain, analyze environmental conditions, identify potential hazards, and discover scientific points of interest.

Our solution supports mission planning by providing route planning tools, terrain visualization, hazard identification, and environmental data integration. By bringing complex Mars data into a single platform, Red Planet Crea makes information easier to understand and use.

The project aims to improve exploration safety, enhance decision-making, and support future human missions to Mars. Through interactive mapping and data visualization, explorers can better understand the Martian environment and plan successful exploration activities.

To develop this concept, we used publicly available NASA datasets, mapping principles, data visualization techniques, presentation tools, and artificial intelligence tools for research, content organization, and project planning.

The creativity of the project lies in transforming scattered Mars data into a practical navigation and exploration system that is accessible, informative, and easy to use for future explorers.
